ننمحق (form VII)
# نَنْمَحِقُ (nanmaḥiqu) /nan.ma.ħi.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْمَحَقَ (inmaḥaqa)
# نَنْمَحِقَ (nanmaḥiqa) /nan.ma.ħi.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْمَحَقَ (inmaḥaqa)
# نَنْمَحِقْ (nanmaḥiq) /nan.ma.ħiq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْمَحَقَ (inmaḥaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
